en.html:
《Life or death: I make the choice a question I must ask myself.》
《Then in the whirl of mocking joy, let comedy's curtain rise.》

《The dog that howls on a stormy night fights bravely with a foolish thief.》
《The chick awaiting its parent in a warm nest rests in a serpent's belly.》
《The lion born beneath dappled light feasts on deer by the thousand.》
《A child scoops up the frogspawn by the stream and tramples it underfoot.》
《You who believe life has meaning, hear the clown's earnest sophistry.》
《You who tremble at death, the devil's mask is a black-painted mirror.》
《Question life, and clown and devil hold their spoons.》
《Believe in life, indulge in life, and clown and devil take off their crowns.》
《Beasts, dance! Race the fields! Sing, shout, rage and run!》
《Every chain and cage before you is now a rotten clod of earth.》

《Between life and death, I laugh at myself and forget myself in rapture.》
《Then let dawn's lament toll the bell, and the divine comedy's curtain rise.》

《The saint performs miracles, saves the people, curses God and vomits.》
《The conqueror in a golden helm subdues ten thousand miles and sinks with his horse to the riverbed.》
《The lake's fair princess leaves her country, chooses love, and drowns in filth at her execution.》
《The orphan drinks earthworm blood for mother's milk; after three nights, its belly rots.》
《Life, hear this hymn, heaping curses exhausted with laughter.》
《Life, hear this prayer, resting upon a joy that trembles with anger.》
《A hundred years of life shall wear chain upon chain of fire and sword.》
《Seven days of life shall shine innocent, guarded by darkness and silence.》
《Beasts, dance! Race the fields! Sing, shout, rage and run!》
《Every chain and cage before you is now a rotten clod of earth.》
